releases.body:
## Summary
- Add `update` as an alias for the installer flow.
- Document the `update` command and cover it with a CLI regression test.
Fix ChatGPT usage bars in recent OpenTUI builds by rendering progress with colored cells instead of Unicode block characters.
Pin OpenCode package installs to the published version so local config no longer reuses stale @latest cache entries.
Fix GPT usage command registration for the current OpenCode keymap API and publish the package artifact.
Updates OpenCode and OpenTUI dependencies to their latest compatible versions.\n\nValidated with typecheck, tests, build, and npm pack dry-run.
